legal_element_controls.articles_28_29: Later conduct cannot retroactively create authorship or participation in an already completed offence; post-offence routes must be tested separately.
legal_element_controls.article_11: Omission requires a result offence, a specific legal or contractual duty or prior creation of risk, real capacity to prevent, equivalence to causing the result and counterfactual causal contribution.
legal_element_controls.article_31bis: First prove an offence-specific legal-person gateway under the text in force; do not import the post-1-July-2015 attribution wording or organisational-model exemption into earlier conduct. In the current framework, keep Article 31 bis.1(a) representatives or authorised decision/control holders, name/account and benefit separate from 31 bis.1(b) corporate activity, subordinate actor, account/benefit and serious supervision failure in the concrete circumstances. Article 129 accessory consequences require an express Code gateway, and Article 31 quinquies exclusions and limits apply. Do not automatically apply corporate liability to a Community or non-personified perimeter.
legal_element_controls.fraud_and_disloyal_administration: Keep current and historical Articles 248–250, all three Article 251 modes and Article 252 separate; deception, induced error, disposition, loss, benefit, authority excess and mental elements apply only where the historical offence requires them. Article 251 includes movable or immovable disposition/encumbrance routes and a separate simulated-contract route.
legal_element_controls.insolvency_offences: Separate Article 257 enforcement frustration (which does not require concurso), Article 258 false or omitted asset declaration and its pre-discovery rectification rule, Article 258 bis unauthorised use of deposited embargoed property, Article 259 actual/imminent or caused insolvency and its numbered acts/prosecution gates, the two Article 260 creditor-preference routes and narrow Article 261; address Article 259.3 imprudence and 259.6 separately.
legal_element_controls.insolvency_administrator_temporal: Do not apply the insolvency-administrator limb of Article 435.4 before 1 July 2015. From then to 11 January 2023 test former Article 432 and its separate Article 252 or 253 routes through Article 435.4. From 12 January 2023 separately test Article 432 appropriation, 432 bis private use and 433 different public use through Article 435.4, including the deliberate legal-payment-order limb, subject to lex mitior and the estate or creditor-interest link. Article 440 requires the Article 439 transaction-participation conduct and is separate; appointment is not automatic public-official guilt.
legal_element_controls.falsity: Separate Article 390.1.4 public-actor false narration from Articles 392 and 395, which incorporate only 390.1.1–3; a private actor's merely untrue narration is not by itself 392/395 falsity. Article 395 requires purpose to prejudice another, and use under Articles 393/396 is separate.
legal_element_controls.judicial: Article 404 requires a knowingly unjust arbitrary administrative resolution and is not judicial prevarication. Separate Article 446 knowing injustice, Article 447 gross negligence or inexcusable ignorance producing a manifestly unjust decision, Article 448 refusal to adjudicate and Article 449 deliberately caused delay for an illegitimate purpose; Article 449 has no separate causal-result element. Identify judge or magistrate versus LAJ or other official. Induced judicial error and knowing judicial injustice are alternatives unless distinct stages or actors are proved.
legal_element_controls.article_451: After proving predicate-offence knowledge, non-participation and later conduct, test separately: no-own-profit assistance to benefit from proceeds; concealment/alteration/disablement of body, effects or instruments to prevent discovery; or evasion assistance limited to listed predicates or abuse of public functions. Apply Articles 452–454; later assistance is not retroactive predicate-offence participation.
legal_element_controls.articles_570bis_570ter: Article 570 bis requires more than two people, stability or indefinite duration and concerted/coordinated task division for an offence purpose. Residual Article 570 ter requires more than two people and concerted offence purpose while lacking one or more organisation characteristics; do not import 570-bis stability/task-division into 570 ter or classify the same grouping and period cumulatively except in the alternative.
legal_element_controls.standard_of_proof: Internal support labels are not conviction thresholds; report investigative lead, charging, trial and conviction sufficiency separately, preserving the presumption of innocence, in dubio pro reo and proof beyond reasonable doubt. Por Derecho assumes the substantiation burden for its assertions; in criminal proceedings the accusing party or parties bear the burden of proving guilt, and no person must disprove the allegation or prove innocence.

priority_issues.title_es: Texto definitivo frente a deuda utilizada en 2022
priority_issues.title_en: Definitive creditor texts versus debt used in 2022
priority_issues.documented_es: El texto definitivo de 2016 refleja 9.052.251,69 € como cifra de clasificación. En la escritura de 2022, los seis componentes impresos suman 13.065.186,68 €; el diferencial de 102.895,34 € hasta 13.168.082,02 € coincide con el paso de 3.079.104,66 € de demora de primer rango al tope hipotecario de 3.182.000 €.
priority_issues.documented_en: The 2016 definitive texts record EUR 9,052,251.69 as a classification figure. In the 2022 deed, the six printed components total EUR 13,065,186.68; the EUR 102,895.34 difference to EUR 13,168,082.02 matches the step from EUR 3,079,104.66 first-rank default interest to the EUR 3,182,000 mortgage cap.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Que 9.052.251,69 € fuera toda la deuda pagadera en 2022 o que cada componente adicional fuera exigible, privilegiado y autorizado.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: That EUR 9,052,251.69 was the entire debt payable in 2022 or that every additional component was payable, privileged and authorised.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: La lista clasificó el crédito en una fase anterior y la deuda posteriormente devengada y cubierta hipotecariamente se extinguió como contraprestación no dineraria.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The list classified the credit at an earlier stage and later accrued, mortgage-covered debt was extinguished as non-cash consideration.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Lista definitiva completa, modificaciones, liquidación a 21/02/2022 y resolución que sustenta cada componente.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Complete definitive list, modifications, 21 February 2022 payoff and the decision supporting each component.
change_log: 2026-08-19: se sustituyó la tesis de cifra sin cálculo por una revisión de exigibilidad componente por componente.

priority_issues.title_es: Oferta, auto de 2021, protocolo 457 y cuentas finales
priority_issues.title_en: Offer, 2021 order, protocol 457 and final accounts
priority_issues.documented_es: La oferta, el auto de 18/05/2021 y la escritura identifican una dación de 159 fincas hipotecadas y una línea separada de 400.000 € para bienes no afectos.
priority_issues.documented_en: The offer, 18 May 2021 order and deed identify a dación of 159 mortgaged properties and a separate EUR 400,000 line for unencumbered assets.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: La conformidad completa entre todos los instrumentos, la comunicación en cinco días y el tratamiento final en las cuentas.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Complete conformity across all instruments, five-day notification and final accounting treatment.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: La escritura ejecutó una dación autorizada y la cifra de deuda era contraprestación no dineraria, no ingreso en efectivo.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The deed implemented an authorised dación and the debt figure was non-cash consideration, not cash proceeds.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Expediente judicial certificado, constancia de la comunicación y rendición final de cuentas.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Certified court file, notification evidence and final rendition of accounts.
change_log: 2026-08-19: la investigación pasó de nulidad universal a conformidad, contabilidad y remedios específicos.

priority_issues.title_en: LPB, Matkator and third-party asset perimeter
priority_issues.documented_es: La certificación RICPE de julio de 2021 distinguió 54 fincas CAM, 190 LPB y 18 de terceros.
priority_issues.documented_en: The July 2021 RICPE certification distinguished 54 CAM properties, 190 LPB properties and 18 third-party properties.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: El título, posesión, acceso, obra y transmisión posterior de cada finca y derecho extraconcursal.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Title, possession, access, works and later transfer of each property and non-insolvency right.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: Sólo se adjudicaron las fincas LPB hipotecadas identificadas y los derechos posteriores descansan sobre títulos facialmente válidos.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: Only the identified mortgaged LPB properties were adjudicated and later rights rest on facially valid titles.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Certificaciones históricas y actuales, anexos exactos y cadena CAM→HNT finca por finca.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Historic and current certificates, exact schedules and the CAM-to-HNT chain property by property.
change_log: 2026-08-19: se reafirmó que LPB era la concursada, no el hotel completo.

priority_issues.documented_es: El auto de 18/05/2021 trata la venta de bienes no afectos por 400.000 € como una línea separada de la dación hipotecaria.
priority_issues.documented_en: The 18 May 2021 order treats the EUR 400,000 sale of unencumbered assets as separate from the mortgage dación.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Pago, retención, devolución, compensación, destino contable, título posterior o doble tratamiento.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Payment, retention, refund, set-off, accounting destination, later title or double treatment.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: La venta fue una operación separada correctamente autorizada y contabilizada fuera del protocolo 457.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The sale was a separate transaction correctly authorised and accounted for outside protocol 457.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Banco, mayor, escritura completa, auto de 24/10/2019 y tracto registral.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Bank record, ledger, complete deed, 24 October 2019 order and Registry chain.
change_log: 2026-08-19: se retiró la inferencia automática de retransmisión de locales por el protocolo 457.

priority_issues.title_en: RICPE conflict, due diligence, reactivation and use of money
priority_issues.documented_es: Existían conexiones de gobierno, retirada previa, título futuro o condicionado y due diligence completa no iniciada en julio de 2021.
priority_issues.documented_en: Governance connections, prior withdrawal, future or conditional title and full due diligence not yet begun were recorded in July 2021.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: La decisión exacta de reactivación, dispensas, drawdowns, uso final de fondos o conocimiento colectivo de irregularidad.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: The exact reactivation decision, waivers, drawdowns, final use of funds or collective knowledge of wrongdoing.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: El proyecto avanzó tras cumplir o dispensar condiciones mediante revisión independiente y con financiación destinada a una operación válida.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The project advanced after conditions were met or waived through independent review and financing was applied to a valid transaction.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Actas de consejo y comité, conflictos, DD, condiciones, dispensas, contratos, bancos y uso de fondos.

priority_issues.title_es: Administración Concursal: control, lealtad, cuentas y causalidad
priority_issues.title_en: Insolvency Administration: control, loyalty, accounts and causation
priority_issues.documented_es: La AC participó en la vía de seguridad/autoridad de 18 de mayo y después describió autorización limitada mientras negó la toma principal. Gil alega actos afirmativos y, por separado, omisión. La participación de los artículos 28–29 exige acto propio; la omisión del artículo 11 exige delito de resultado, deber legal o contractual específico o creación previa del riesgo, capacidad real de impedir, equivalencia y causalidad contrafactual. La conducta posterior no crea participación retroactiva.
priority_issues.documented_en: The Insolvency Administration participated in the 18 May security/authority route and later described limited authority while denying the principal takeover. Gil alleges affirmative acts and, separately, omission. Articles 28–29 participation requires an own act; Article 11 omission requires a result offence, a specific legal or contractual duty or prior creation of risk, real capacity to prevent, equivalence and counterfactual causation. Later conduct does not create retroactive participation.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Acto afirmativo penalmente participativo; cada elemento del artículo 11; encaje temporal del artículo 435.4 o 440; conocimiento, intención, contribución causal o vínculo con masa y acreedores.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: A criminally participatory affirmative act; each Article 11 element; temporal fit under Article 435.4 or 440; knowledge, intent, causal contribution or estate-and-creditor link.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: La liquidación estaba abierta, no existió consignación completa y la AC podía seguir la vía autorizada y discrepar de la alternativa del socio.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: Liquidation was open, complete consignment had not occurred and the Administrator could follow the authorised route and disagree with the shareholder alternative.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Expediente AC, comunicaciones contemporáneas, decisiones internas, cifras oficiales y cuentas finales.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Administrator file, contemporaneous communications, internal decisions, official figures and final accounts.
change_log: 2026-08-19: se separó efecto adverso de conocimiento, intención y causalidad penal.
2026-08-23: se añadió la vía afirmativa 18-May→7-Jun, el mandato limitado/negativa y la escalera de cuatro niveles sin convertir la alegación en hallazgo.
2026-08-26: se separaron participación afirmativa, artículo 11, conducta posterior y rutas temporales específicas del administrador concursal.

priority_issues.title_es: Separación acto por acto entre juez y LAJ
priority_issues.documented_es: Gil alega que resoluciones, negativas y demoras identificadas de Alberto López Villarrubia preservaron el resultado de control privado. Deben separarse: artículo 446, sentencia o resolución injusta a sabiendas; 447, imprudencia grave o ignorancia inexcusable; 448, negativa a juzgar; y 449, retardo malicioso. El artículo 404 es solo administrativo. Debe distinguirse juez o magistrado de LAJ u otro funcionario, y el error judicial inducido de la injusticia judicial consciente salvo fases o actores distintos.
priority_issues.documented_en: Gil alleges that identified resolutions, refusals and delays by Alberto López Villarrubia preserved the private-control result. The routes must remain separate: Article 446, knowingly unjust judgment or decision; 447, gross negligence or inexcusable ignorance; 448, refusal to adjudicate; and 449, malicious delay. Article 404 is administrative only. Judge or magistrate must be distinguished from LAJ or other official, and induced judicial error from knowing judicial injustice unless distinct stages or actors are proved.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Conocimiento personal de cada uso externo, coordinación, favoritismo, injusticia consciente o causalidad de cada efecto posterior.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Personal knowledge of every external use, coordination, favouritism, knowing injustice or causation of every later effect.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: Las decisiones jurisdiccionales fueron razonadas dentro del expediente y las actuaciones de oficina se limitaron a ejecutar o certificar lo ordenado.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: Jurisdictional decisions were reasoned within the file and court-office acts merely implemented or certified what had been ordered.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Expediente certificado, LexNET, notificaciones, recursos, firmeza, testimonios y registro de comunicación del protocolo 457.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Certified file, LexNET, service, appeals, finality, testimonies and the protocol 457 notification record.
change_log: 2026-08-19: se prohibió atribuir decisiones jurisdiccionales al LAJ o actos de oficina al juez sin fuente primaria.
2026-08-23: la prevaricación por omisión queda como alegación atribuida y se exige resolución/negativa/demora exacta, deber, injusticia, conocimiento o finalidad y causalidad.
2026-08-26: se separaron artículos 446–449, clases de actor y las alternativas de fraude procesal e injusticia judicial consciente.

priority_issues.documented_es: La llamada de 22 de marzo con atribución contextual, el nodo de 18 de mayo, los relatos y denuncia de 7 de junio y las declaraciones de julio hacen concreta e investigable una alegación de preparación, instrucción y ejecución coordinada CAM/Comunidad/seguridad.
priority_issues.documented_en: The contextually attributed 22 March call, 18 May node, 7 June reports and pleading, and July declarations make a CAM/Community/security preparation, instruction and coordinated-implementation allegation concrete and investigable.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Objetivo común, reparto de funciones, comunicaciones coordinadas, destrucción de prueba o represalia causalmente vinculada.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Common objective, role allocation, coordinated communications, destruction of evidence or causally linked retaliation.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: Los actos fueron independientes, facialmente regulares y explicables por roles, tiempos y decisiones separadas.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The acts were independent, facially regular and explained by separate roles, timing and decisions.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Comunicaciones, instrucciones, reuniones, documentos compartidos, cronología y prueba exculpatoria.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Communications, instructions, meetings, shared documents, chronology and exculpatory evidence.
change_log: 2026-08-19: la ventaja repetida quedó definida como razón para investigar, no como prueba automática de coordinación.
2026-08-23: se elevó la instrucción directa a alegación penal actor-específica; siguen sin probarse la orden operativa JDAM/FMMM y el mandato o participación exacta de Laura Patricia Acosta Matos.

priority_issues.title_es: Propagación de premisas disputadas a través de actos formales
priority_issues.title_en: Propagation of disputed premises through formal acts
priority_issues.documented_es: Crédito, control material, valoración, resoluciones, escritura, Registro, HNT, RICPE y operación forman una cadena documental verificable.
priority_issues.documented_en: Credit, material control, valuation, decisions, deed, Registry, HNT, RICPE and operation form a traceable documentary chain.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Que una misma premisa falsa originara toda la cadena o que cada receptor conociera su falsedad.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: That one false premise originated the entire chain or that every recipient knew it was false.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: Cada acto tenía título y función propios y no dependía de una premisa común ilícita.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: Each act had its own title and function and did not depend on a common unlawful premise.
change_log: 2026-08-19: la página 360° quedó definida como metodología de dependencia, no como conclusión de invalidez.

priority_issues.documented_es: El activo físico aparece en capas concursales, RICPE, HNT, incentivos, FEDER y operación actual.
priority_issues.documented_en: The physical asset appears across insolvency, RICPE, HNT, incentives, ERDF and present operation layers.
priority_issues.not_proved_es: Duplicidad material de gastos, empleo, activos o valor; procedencia ilícita; conocimiento de inversores o autoridades.
priority_issues.not_proved_en: Material duplication of costs, employment, assets or value; unlawful proceeds; investor or authority knowledge.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_es: Las capas financiaron conceptos, periodos y beneficiarios distintos y fueron correctamente declaradas y controladas.
priority_issues.strongest_defence_en: The layers financed distinct concepts, periods and beneficiaries and were correctly declared and controlled.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_es: Contratos, drawdowns, bancos, facturas, nóminas, ayudas, declaraciones de acumulación y trazabilidad de valor.
priority_issues.decisive_next_source_en: Contracts, drawdowns, banks, invoices, payroll, aid records, cumulation declarations and value traceability.
change_log: 2026-08-19: coexistencia financiera se distinguió de duplicidad o ilicitud probada.
